description: FIX_HEAVY_CREEP (ships OFF): a unit T7-26 would freeze for its [HEAVY] +1 to hit makes a Normal move of 3" or less instead when that buys cover, its objective's range or a firing lane and keeps every [HEAVY] target - 11e 24.16: [HEAVY] adds 1 to the hit roll if the unit is unengaged, was not set up this turn and no model in it moved more than 3" (10e needed it to Remain Stationary). Same position as exam mv10: Custodian Guard Beta carries a constructed 36" BS 4+ [HEAVY] heavy bolter just north of area-medium-7, a LIGHT (obscuring, 13.10) area it is not within, so it cannot see its only target, Custodian Guard Alpha, and T7-26 freezes it for +1 to hit on nothing. With tests/bench_profiles/heavy_creep_on.json loaded, the real Suggest (K) card for Beta reads 'Custodian Guard Beta moves toward obj... (creeping N" to keep its [HEAVY] +1 to hit, into cover...)' with the 'How this turn's move was shaped' note (no model moves more than 3", the Benefit of Cover, the new sight line). Clearing the profile restores the shipped default: T7-26's 'holds for Heavy weapon bonus'. Reloading restores the creep; the player clicks the card's Accept and the game carries it out - the engine then records a Normal move of 1-3" (flags.moved_max_inches), [HEAVY] still applies, every model has the Benefit of Cover and Alpha is an eligible target. The guard: Custodian Guard Delta, the same gun with its target already in sight and no terrain within reach, still holds for its Heavy weapon bonus.
